source: Primavera P6 Professional 23.12.1, standalone SQLite database; each probe imported on its own (Create New Project) and scheduled once (F9, own data date) on 14 October 2026, then read back read-only. Values for every unfinished activity: early start / finish (the restart and remaining early finish of work under way), late start (the remaining late start of work under way) and late finish to the minute, total and free float in hours. Left out: in ZZ-CPP-H3S-M and -MO, F3 and S3 (a Mandatory Start on a finish milestone, a Mandatory Finish on a start milestone), which P6's XER import stored as completed with no dates, and the predecessor and successor rows next to them.
